messages.subject: Schneider Electric Thailand | Impact 2030, industrial sustainability and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Tangsiriwich,

Schneider Electric's Impact 2030 direction, energy-management leadership and current focus on smarter industrial infrastructure align closely with the work I have been leading at the intersection of industry, institutions and sustainability.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy. I work across technical and corporate teams to convert regulatory obligations, community priorities and sustainability commitments into accountable action.

My recent experience includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage at a remote mining operation, plus carbon-accounting readiness based on physical operating data. That work has reinforced a principle I would bring to Schneider Electric: sustainability becomes commercially credible when strategy, data, operating ownership and stakeholder confidence move together.

I would value consideration for Thailand, Laos, Myanmar or wider ASEAN responsibilities in sustainability, external affairs, strategic partnerships, country strategy or industrial stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Schneider Electric-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
